description: PromQL fixture for the Prometheus release-gate check: every panel expression of the two most-downloaded community Neo4j dashboards on Grafana.com that target self-managed Neo4j over Prometheus (10371 'Neo4j Dashboard' revision 1 and 12046 'neo4j version 5 dashboard' revisions 2 and 1). Shape: `dashboards` identifies each dashboard revision (id, revision, title, author, downloads, dates, URLs, SHA-256 of the downloaded JSON, the Neo4j name-form era its names belong to, and its template variables, which a replay must substitute); `expectation_tags` is the vocabulary of `expect`; `expressions` has one entry per panel target, in dashboard and panel order: `dashboard` and `revision` (keys into `dashboards`), `panel`, `panel_type`, `ref_id`, `expr` (the verbatim PromQL), `metric_names` (literal metric names in expr), `name_regexes` (__name__ regexes in expr), `expr_2026_10_form` (expr with every literal name rewritten into the 2026.10 Prometheus form that DozerDB emits, or null when the expression selects names by regex, which cannot be rewritten mechanically), `names_2026_10_form` (the 2026.10-form names the expression reads, regexes expanded to the names they matched on a server of their era), `verbatim_is_2026_10_form` (true when expr needs no rewrite), and `expect` (what a replay against a DozerDB 2026.10 server with the default filter must find, see expectation_tags). A replay runs expr verbatim where verbatim_is_2026_10_form is true, expr_2026_10_form otherwise, and the names in names_2026_10_form for regex expressions. Extracted from the dashboards' JSON as the Grafana.com API serves it (see generated_from and selection_rule); change it only to record a documented error.
generated_from: grafana.com public API, catalogue pages 1-102 of /api/dashboards?orderBy=downloads&direction=desc&pageSize=100, fetched 2026-10-30T03:13Z
selection_rule: dashboards whose name, slug, description or readme mention neo4j; the two with the most downloads that target self-managed Neo4j over Prometheus

expectation_tags.data-with-default-filter: every metric the expression reads is documented in the Operations Manual 2026.10, DozerDB emits it and the verbatim 2026.10 default server.metrics.filter admits it: the replay requires at least one series
expectation_tags.data-only-if-filter-widened: every metric is documented and emitted, but at least one is outside the default filter (page_cache.pins, transaction.started, vm.gc.count.*, log.*, ...): data only with server.metrics.filter widened
expectation_tags.not-applicable-clustering: Raft or store-copy metrics that a single-instance server never emits: the replay requires no series
expectation_tags.not-a-neo4j-metric: Prometheus's own `up` or a custom procedure metric of the dashboard author: not DozerDB's to emit
expectation_tags.stale-name-no-2026-10-equivalent: a metric Neo4j removed (bolt.sessions_started): no 2026.10 name exists
expectation_tags.regex-matches-nothing: the dashboard's own __name__ regex can match no metric on any server
